# Welcome to Unravel Carbon API

The **Unravel Carbon Public API** empowers organizations to seamlessly access, analyze, and integrate comprehensive carbon emissions data into their sustainability workflows.

## Quick Start Guide

 **Get Your API Key**:
   - Log in to your [Unravel dashboard](https://app.unravelcarbon.com/)
   - Navigate to [Integrations](https://app.unravelcarbon.com/integrations)
   - Create a new API key

## Authentication

All API endpoints require authentication using **Bearer tokens**. Include your API key in the Authorization header:

`
Authorization: Bearer your_api_key_here
`

## What You Can Do

- **Raw Data Access**: Retrieve granular emissions data with advanced filtering options
- **Aggregated Analytics**: Get summarized insights with flexible grouping and calculations
- **Real-time Sync**: Check for data updates to keep your systems synchronized  
- **Metadata Management**: Access facility structures and emission categories
- **Export Capabilities**: Download data in JSON or CSV formats for further analysis
- **Direct Data Ingestion**: Upload data directly using the API for automatic processing.
- **Access audit reports**: Export active user listings, user-to-role mappings, role-to-function matrices, and privileged access activity history for IT access reviews.

## Common Use Cases

- **Sustainability Reporting**: Generate periodic emissions reports by facility or category
- **Supply Chain Analysis**: Track emissions by supplier and spend category
- **Trend Analysis**: Monitor emissions changes over time with update tracking
- **Data Integration**: Sync emissions data with business intelligence tools
- **Compliance Monitoring**: Export data for regulatory reporting requirements

## Response Formats

- **JSON** (default): Structured data for programmatic access
- **CSV**: Download links for spreadsheet analysis and reporting

## Rate Limits

- **Standard**: 20 requests per minute (sliding window)
- Rate limit headers are included in all responses
- Recommended minimum interval: **5 seconds per request**
